'''Adarian traveler's lower robes''' were an item of light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were [[red]] and [[gray]] in color and designed to hang from the wearer's waist down to the floor covering the feet. Whether they were made by the [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] or just named for them is unclear.
